title: Cerebrovascular Registry
brief_summary: Patients with stroke were registered based on the WHO/ MONICA protocol and were followed-up for 28 days, starting in 2015 in PROVE Registry
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\* patients with acute Stroke (Hemorrhagic and Non Hemorrhagic)

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients who do not agree to continue cooperation
* patients with incomplete documents
study_population: patients with stroke or stroke history
